title: Online Excel Editor — Edit XLSX Workbooks in Your Browser
description: Online Excel workbook editor powered by OnlyOffice. Sign in to sync .xlsx files to your account, open them anywhere, and autosave as you work. Local editing still available without an account.
ogDescription: Edit Excel workbooks online — sign in to sync .xlsx to your account, or open a file locally in the browser.
badge: Instant setup · Cloud sync · Local fallback
sub: Create, edit, and sync Excel workbooks with OnlyOffice in your browser. Sign in for cloud workbooks, or open a local file — no install, no bloat.

recent.label: Continue editing
recent.note: Cloud workbooks sync to your account when you are signed in. Local recovery copies still stay in this browser for 7 days — inspect them on the history page.

loved.label: Built for creators, startups, and teams who want Excel in the browser

features.h2: Say goodbye to bloated suites. Welcome to focused productivity.
features.p: OnlyOffice in the tab, cloud workbooks when you sign in, and a local path that never needs an account — clean editing without the desktop install.

items.p: Formulas, charts, sheets and formatting via OnlyOffice WebAssembly — no desktop Office required.
Workbooks in your account travel with you. Start on one device, continue on another.
Open a file on this device only, or use local recovery history — no account required for that path.

essentials.p: The editor stays out of the way: cloud library when you need it, local recovery when you do not, and formats beyond Excel when the job calls for them.

items.label: Cloud library
items.p: Sign in once. Browse, open, and autosave .xlsx files stored in your account — then pick up on another device.

items.label: Organization
items.p: Spreadsheets are the product. The same engine still opens Word, PowerPoint, PDF and OpenDocument when you need them.

items.label: Access
items.p: Cloud sync needs an account. Local open and seven-day recovery copies do not — choose the path that fits the file.

items.label: Offline ready
items.p: Once editor assets are cached, keep editing a local file without the network. Cloud save waits until you are online.

band.h2: Ready for a faster, lighter spreadsheet workflow?
band.p: Sign in to sync workbooks to your account, or open a local .xlsx and start editing in the tab — OnlyOffice, no install.

foot.blurb: The lightweight online Excel and document editor for modern teams — cloud sync when you sign in, local editing when you do not.

faqLd.q: What happens if I close the tab?
faqLd.a: Signed-in workbooks are written back by save and autosave. Separately, local recovery copies can stay in this browser for 7 days — see the history page. Cloud files remain in your account.

Sign in to sync workbooks to your account and use My workbooks. You can still open a local .xlsx without signing in; that path stays on this device (plus optional local recovery copies in this browser).
Excel (.xlsx) is the primary product. The same editor also opens Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF and CSV, powered by OnlyOffice in WebAssembly.

featureList: Online Excel (.xlsx) workbook editor in the browser
Sign in to sync workbooks to your account
Also open DOCX, PPTX, PDF and CSV
Installable PWA with offline support for local editing
